verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה שָׁנָ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·têm ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mə·naš·šeh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wa·ḥă·miš·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Manasseh was twelve . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five . . . years
verses.literalPt: Manassés tinha doze anos quando começou a reinar e reinou cinquenta e cinco anos em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hō·w·rîš Yah·weh mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD by following the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Fez o mal à vista de Jeová, segundo as abominações dos povos que Jeová expulsou de diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּ֗שָׁב וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּ֖ץ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּח֤וֹת לַבְּעָלִים֙ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֲשֵׁר֔וֹת וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ לְכָל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer nit·taṣ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’ā·ḇîw way·yā·qem miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ lab·bə·‘ā·lîm way·ya·‘aś ’ă·šê·rō·wṯ way·yiš·ta·ḥū lə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·ma·yim way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: For he rebuilt . . . the high places that his father Hezekiah had torn down and he raised up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles And he worshiped and served all the host of heaven
verses.literalPt: Pois tornou a edificar os altos que Ezequias, seu pai, tinha demolido; levantou altares para os Baalins, fabricou Asterotes, adorou a todo o exército do céu e o serviu.

verses.original: וּבָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּח֖וֹת בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם יִֽהְיֶה־ שְּׁמִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nāh miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim yih·yeh- šə·mî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Manasseh also built altars in the house of the LORD of which the LORD had said My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever
verses.literalPt: Edificou também altares na Casa de Jeová, da qual disse Jeová: Em Jerusalém, estará eternamente o meu nome.

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְכָל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּשְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ lə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim biš·tê ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: In both courtyards of the house of the LORD he built altars to all the host of heaven
verses.literalPt: Edificou altares a todo o exército do céu nos dois átrios da Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְהוּא֩ הֶעֱבִ֨יר אֶת־ בָּנָ֤יו בָּאֵשׁ֙ בְּגֵ֣י בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם וְעוֹנֵ֤ן וְנִחֵשׁ֙ וְֽכִשֵּׁ֔ף וְעָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְיִדְּעוֹנִ֑י הִרְבָּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū he·‘ĕ·ḇîr ’eṯ- bā·nāw bā·’êš bə·ḡê ḇen- hin·nōm wə·‘ō·w·nên wə·ni·ḥêš wə·ḵiš·šêp̄ wə·‘ā·śāh ’ō·wḇ wə·yid·də·‘ō·w·nî hir·bāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·haḵ·‘î·sōw
verses.literal: He sacrificed his sons in the fire in the Valley of Ben-hinnom He practiced sorcery divination and witchcraft and consulted mediums and spiritists He did great evil in the sight of the LORD provoking Him to anger
verses.literalPt: Além disso, fez passar seus filhos pelo fogo no vale do Filho de Hinom. Praticava augúrios, usava de encantamentos, dava-se a artes mágicas e tratava com os que chamavam espíritos e os que tinham espíritos familiares; fez muito mal à vista de Jeová, para o provocar à ira.

verses.original: וַיָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת־ פֶּ֥סֶל הַסֶּ֖מֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ דָּוִיד֙ וְאֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ בַּבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֙רְתִּי֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־ שְׁמִ֖י לְעֵילֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- pe·sel has·se·mel ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bə·ḇêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- dā·wîḏ wə·’el- šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tî mik·kōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- šə·mî lə·‘ê·lō·wm
verses.literal: Manasseh even took the carved image he had made and set it up in the house of God of which God had said to David . . . and his son Solomon In this temple and in Jerusalem which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel I will establish My Name forever
verses.literalPt: A imagem esculpida do ídolo que tinha feito, ele a colocou na Casa de Deus, da qual disse Deus a Davi e a Salomão, seu filho: Nesta casa, em Jerusalém, que escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel, estabelecerei o meu nome para sempre,

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִ֗יף לְהָסִיר֙ אֶת־ רֶ֣גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתִּי לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם רַ֣ק׀ אִם־ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ים לְכָל־ הַתּוֹרָ֛ה וְהַֽחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ō·w·sîp̄ lə·hā·sîr ’eṯ- re·ḡel yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem raq ’im- yiš·mə·rū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯîm lə·ḵāl hat·tō·w·rāh wə·ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·ham·miš·pā·ṭîm bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to leave - the land that I assigned to your fathers if only they are careful to do all that I have commanded them through Moses all the laws statutes and judgments
verses.literalPt: nem removerei mais o pé de Israel da terra que destinei para vossos pais, contanto que tenham cuidado de fazer tudo o que lhes ordenei, a saber, toda a lei e os estatutos e as ordenanças, dados por intervenção de Moisés.

verses.original: וַיֶּ֣תַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת רָ֔ע מִן־ הַ֨גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ṯa‘ mə·naš·šeh ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim la·‘ă·śō·wṯ rā‘ min- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hiš·mîḏ Yah·weh mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Manasseh led the people of Judah and Jerusalem astray so that they did greater evil than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Manassés fez errar a Judá e aos habitantes de Jerusalém, de maneira que fizeram o mal ainda mais do que as nações que Jeová destruiu de diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה וְאֶל־ עַמּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א הִקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mə·naš·šeh wə·’el- ‘am·mōw wə·lō hiq·šî·ḇū
verses.literal: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh . . . and his people but they did not listen
verses.literalPt: Jeová falou a Manassés e ao seu povo, porém não se importaram.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה בַּחֹחִ֑ים וַיַּֽאַסְרֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַיּוֹלִיכֻ֖הוּ בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- śā·rê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ’ă·šer lə·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yil·kə·ḏū ’eṯ- mə·naš·šeh ba·ḥō·ḥîm way·ya·’as·ru·hū ban·ḥuš·ta·yim way·yō·w·lî·ḵu·hū bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: So the LORD brought against them the military commanders of the king of Assyria who captured Manasseh put a hook in his nose bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Pelo que Jeová fez vir sobre eles os capitães do exército do rei da Assíria, os quais o prenderam, e amarraram com grilhões, e o levaram para Babilônia.

verses.original: וּכְהָצֵ֣ר ל֔וֹ חִלָּ֕ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיִּכָּנַ֣ע מְאֹ֔ד מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·hā·ṣêr lōw ḥil·lāh ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yik·kā·na‘ mə·’ōḏ mil·lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: And in his distress Manasseh sought the favor of the LORD his God and earnestly humbled himself before the God of his fathers
verses.literalPt: Estando em aperto, suplicou a Jeová, seu Deus, e humilhou-se muito diante do Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֗יו וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע תְּחִנָּת֔וֹ וַיְשִׁיבֵ֥הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְמַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣דַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֥וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’ê·lāw way·yê·‘ā·ṯer lōw way·yiš·ma‘ tə·ḥin·nā·ṯōw way·šî·ḇê·hū yə·rū·šā·lim lə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw way·yê·ḏa‘ mə·naš·šeh kî Yah·weh hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And when he prayed to Him the LORD received his plea and heard his petition So He brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom Then Manasseh knew that the LORD . . . is God
verses.literalPt: Orou a ele; Deus aceitou-lhe a petição, ouviu-lhe a súplica e tornou a trazê-lo a Jerusalém, ao seu reino. Então, reconheceu Manassés que Jeová era Deus.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֡ן בָּנָ֣ה חוֹמָ֣ה חִֽיצוֹנָ֣ה׀ לְעִיר־ דָּוִ֡יד מַעְרָבָה֩ לְגִיח֨וֹן בַּנַּ֜חַל וְלָב֨וֹא בְשַׁ֤עַר הַדָּגִים֙ וְסָבַ֣ב לָעֹ֔פֶל וַיַּגְבִּיהֶ֖הָ מְאֹ֑ד וַיָּ֧שֶׂם שָֽׂרֵי־ חַ֛יִל בְּכָל־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת בִּיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên bā·nāh ḥō·w·māh ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh lə·‘îr- dā·wîḏ ma‘·rā·ḇāh lə·ḡî·ḥō·wn ban·na·ḥal wə·lā·ḇō·w ḇə·ša·‘ar had·dā·ḡîm wə·sā·ḇaḇ lā·‘ō·p̄el way·yaḡ·bî·he·hā mə·’ōḏ way·yā·śem śā·rê- ḥa·yil bə·ḵāl he·‘ā·rîm hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ bî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: After this Manasseh rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David from west of Gihon in the valley to the entrance of the Fish Gate and he brought it around the hill of Ophel and heightened it considerably He also stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, depois disso, edificou um muro do lado de fora da Cidade de Davi, ao ocidente de Giom, no vale, até a entrada da Porta dos Peixes; fê-lo passar ao redor de Ofel e levantou-o muito alto. Pôs capitães do exército em todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּסַר אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֨י הַנֵּכָ֤ר וְאֶת־ הַסֶּ֙מֶל֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְכָל־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֛ה בְּהַ֥ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ ח֥וּצָה לָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sar ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê han·nê·ḵār wə·’eṯ- has·se·mel mib·bêṯ Yah·weh wə·ḵāl ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh bə·har bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim way·yaš·lêḵ ḥū·ṣāh lā·‘îr
verses.literal: He removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the LORD along with all the altars he had built on the temple mount and in Jerusalem and he dumped them outside the city
verses.literalPt: Tirou da Casa de Jeová os deuses estranhos, e o ídolo, e todos os altares que tinha edificado no monte da Casa de Jeová e em Jerusalém e lançou-os fora da cidade.

verses.original: וַיָּכֶן אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח עָלָ֔יו זִבְחֵ֥י שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְתוֹדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לִֽיהוּדָ֔ה לַעֲב֕וֹד אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yå̄·ḵɛn ’eṯ- miz·baḥ Yah·weh way·yiz·baḥ ‘ā·lāw ziḇ·ḥê šə·lā·mîm wə·ṯō·w·ḏāh way·yō·mer lî·hū·ḏāh la·‘ă·ḇō·wḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then he restored the altar of the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings and thank offerings on it and he told Judah to serve the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Restituiu o altar de Jeová, ofereceu sobre ele sacrifícios de ofertas pacíficas e de ação de graças e ordenou a Judá que servisse a Jeová, Deus de Israel.

verses.original: אֲבָל֙ ע֣וֹד הָעָ֔ם זֹבְחִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת רַ֖ק לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl ‘ō·wḏ hā·‘ām zō·ḇə·ḥîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ raq Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed at the high places but only to the LORD their God
verses.literalPt: Contudo, o povo ainda sacrificava nos altos, mas tão somente a Jeová, seu Deus.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁה֮ וּתְפִלָּת֣וֹ אֶל־ אֱלֹהָיו֒ וְדִבְרֵי֙ הַֽחֹזִ֔ים הַֽמְדַבְּרִ֣ים אֵלָ֔יו בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּ֕ם עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê mə·naš·šeh ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯōw ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·ḏiḇ·rê ha·ḥō·zîm ham·ḏab·bə·rîm ’ê·lāw bə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nām ‘al- diḇ·rê mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh along with his prayer to his God and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD the God of Israel they are indeed written in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o resto dos atos de Manassés, e a sua oração a seu Deus, e as palavras dos videntes que lhe falaram em nome de Jeová, Deus de Israel, estão escritos nos Atos dos Reis de Israel.

verses.original: וּתְפִלָּת֣וֹ וְהֵֽעָתֶר־ לוֹ֮ וְכָל־ חַטָּאת֣וֹ וּמַעְלוֹ֒ וְהַמְּקֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּנָ֨ה בָהֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֣ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י הִכָּנְע֑וֹ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י חוֹזָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯōw wə·hê·‘ā·ṯer- lōw wə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ū·ma‘·lōw wə·ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh ḇā·hem bā·mō·wṯ wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ hā·’ă·šê·rîm wə·hap·pə·si·lîm lip̄·nê hik·kā·nə·‘ōw hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al diḇ·rê ḥō·w·zāy
verses.literal: His prayer and how God received his plea as well as all his sin and unfaithfulness and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself they are indeed written in the Records of the Seers
verses.literalPt: Também a sua oração, e como Deus aceitou a sua petição, e todo o seu pecado e a sua transgressão, e os lugares em que edificou altos e colocou os Aserins e as imagens esculpidas, antes de se humilhar, eis que estão escritos na História de Hozai.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ mə·naš·šeh ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·ru·hū bê·ṯōw way·yim·lōḵ ’ā·mō·wn bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried at his palace And his son Amon reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Manassés com seus pais, e sepultaram-no na sua casa. Em lugar dele, reinou seu filho Amom.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּשְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה אָמ֣וֹן בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh ’ā·mō·wn bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nîm mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Amon was twenty-two . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem two years
verses.literalPt: Tinha Amom vinte e dois anos quando começou a reinar e reinou dois anos em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑יו וּֽלְכָל־ הַפְּסִילִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֔יו זִבַּ֥ח אָמ֖וֹן וַיַּֽעַבְדֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mə·naš·šeh ’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·ḵāl- hap·pə·sî·lîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mə·naš·šeh ’ā·ḇîw zib·baḥ ’ā·mō·wn way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏêm
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD as his father Manasseh had done Amon served and sacrificed to all the idols that his father Manasseh had made
verses.literalPt: Fez o mal à vista de Jeová, como fez seu pai Manassés; sacrificou a todas as imagens esculpidas que Manassés, seu pai, tinha feito e as serviu.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א נִכְנַע֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כְּהִכָּנַ֖ע מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑יו כִּ֛י ה֥וּא אָמ֖וֹן הִרְבָּ֥ה אַשְׁמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō niḵ·na‘ mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh kə·hik·kā·na‘ mə·naš·šeh ’ā·ḇîw kî hū ’ā·mō·wn hir·bāh ’aš·māh
verses.literal: but he did not humble himself before the LORD as his father Manasseh had done instead . . . Amon increased his guilt
verses.literalPt: Não se humilhou diante de Jeová, como seu pai Manassés se tinha humilhado, mas este Amom transgrediu mais e mais.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשְׁר֤וּ עָלָיו֙ עֲבָדָ֔יו וַיְמִיתֻ֖הוּ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šə·rū ‘ā·lāw ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·mî·ṯu·hū bə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed him in his palace
verses.literalPt: Tendo os seus servos conspirado contra ele, tiraram-lhe a vida na sua casa.

verses.original: וַיַּכּוּ֙ עַם־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַקֹּֽשְׁרִ֖ים עַל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָמ֑וֹן וַיַּמְלִ֧יכוּ עַם־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kū ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’êṯ kāl- haq·qō·šə·rîm ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·mō·wn way·yam·lî·ḵū ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- yō·šî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon and they made his son Josiah king . . . . . . in his place
verses.literalPt: Mas o povo da terra matou a todos os que conspiraram contra o rei Amom e fez reinar em lugar dele seu filho Josias.
